funnel.title: Brands come to you
funnel.lead: Working with brands on your own means hunting for them, sending your media kit and waiting for replies, again and again. Here brands post what they need, and briefs that fit you show up in your feed.

points.feed: Briefs you qualify for land in your feed, with a match score.
points.budget: Every brief shows the budget or the barter up front.
points.offers: Post your services and let brands send you requests.

earn.lead: Apply to briefs from brands, or put up your own services and let brands come to you.

briefs.title: Apply to briefs
briefs.body: Pick a brief that fits, write a short pitch and follow its status.

commission.title: No commission
commission.body: Whatever you agree with a brand is yours. We don’t take a cut.

private.title: Your contacts stay private
private.body: A brand sees how to reach you only after it accepts you.

choice.title: You decide
choice.body: Withdraw an application before it’s accepted, or decline any request you don’t like.

followers.q: How many followers do I need?
followers.a: There’s no fixed minimum. Each brand sets its own in the brief, and your feed shows only the briefs you qualify for.

pay.a: The brand pays you directly, in money or barter, as the brief says. Payments don’t go through briefluence, and we take no commission.

plans.q: What’s the difference between Basic and Pro?
plans.a: Every new blogger gets 30 days of Pro for free. After that Basic stays free, with a limit on applications and live service cards. Pro has no limits.

review.q: Why do you check my profile and accounts?
review.a: So brands can trust what they see. We look at every profile and every added account before it counts. Accounts must be public. This keeps fake accounts out.

noReply.q: What if a brand doesn’t reply?
noReply.a: You see when a brand opens your application. If nothing happens, you can withdraw it any time before it’s accepted and focus on other briefs.
